data.one_liner: A library for working with Google Sheets API v4 in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to manage spreadsheets, read and write cell data, handle worksheets, and perform batch updates using the Google Sheets API v4. Provides utility classes for range management and data exporting.
use_when: You need to read or write data to Google Sheets from a Dart or Flutter application.
You want to manage spreadsheets, rows, and columns programmatically.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose local database instead of cloud-hosted spreadsheets.
You require real-time collaborative editing UI widgets out of the box.
strengths: Simplifies interaction with the Google Sheets API v4.
Supports fetching all rows/columns, batch updates, and exporting to various formats like CSV, XLSX, and PDF.
weaknesses: Requires setting up Google Cloud credentials and OAuth configuration.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining Google API credentials (service account or OAuth) and managing authorization.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making raw HTTP REST requests directly to the Google Sheets API without a dedicated wrapper library.
